All 20 three-metric selections and all three adaptive routes passed in the exact offline production build. Unit checks cover every valid integer allocation, locked-value conservation, all confirmation orders, minimum/maximum bounds, total 100, near-even thresholds and contrast/rebalance conditions.

Each priority retains at least 10 percent, matching the supplied HTML prototype. Integer points replace half-point sliders to distribute the remainder exactly with at most a one-point difference. The three sliders share a visual 0–100 scale and expose the currently allowed range.

Publishing automatically opens exactly three metric/intensity shots. Narrative V2 near-even override produces three medium shots; otherwise the original low/medium/high thresholds apply. No invented numerical effort transform or learning score is displayed.

The compared pair contains actual tested immutable snapshots. An already near-even first run requests a clear contrast; an uneven first run requests an improved balance. A partially rebalanced second run offers an explicit third 34/33/33 balance check.
